members.name: for
members.description:
Specifier for list of form associated or contentEditable peer elements that 
should partake in forming the URL.

members.name: as
members.description: Indicates whether to treat the response as HTML or JSON or Text

members.name: method
members.description: The http verb to be used for the request

members.name: body
members.description:
Either the JSON stringified or the parsed JSON object 
If parsed, the web component will stringify it.

members.name: target
members.description:
Directed Scoped Specifier to the 
DOM element where the retrieved content should be applied.

members.name: shadow
members.description: If as=html, specify whether to (stream) the contents into an attached shadow DOM or not.

members.name: noCache
members.description: Do not cache results even if the url has been invoked before.

members.name: stream
members.description: Stream the contents into the target element

members.name: when
members.description:
Directed Scoped Specifier to a 
(button) element, to delay submitting the fetch request until that button is clicked.

members.name: form
members.description:
Directed Scoped Specifier to a form element
that we should use to form the url and body from.
